Title: Daring the Dawn->Mask of a 1000 faces->Eagle's Sight

Messages.Author: Kaisharga
Messages.Body:
If a vampire plays daring the dawn and the prey decides not to block.
Then the acting Methuselah plays with another vampire Mask of a 1000
faces to continue the action with this vampire instead. I know that
the prey by not blocking has not another opportunity to block. Can he
block with one of his minions by playing eagle's sight? (And I think
that any other Methuselah can attempt to block with ES.)

Thanks in advance.

Kaisharga

.....heaven shall burn when we are gathered.....
-The Baali are here to stay
